correctness.rationale: The shared iid Gaussian query matrix G gives rowwise diagonal error delta_i=sum_{j != i}A_ij (g_i.g_j)/||g_i||². Conditional variance uses E[1/chi_q²]=1/(q-2); distinct-row covariances vanish except the reciprocal pair, whose angular-square expectation is 1/q. Summing yields Var(E)=||A_off||_F²/(q-2)+(2/q)sum_{i<j}A_ij A_ji = 2(q-1)/(q(q-2))||S_off||_F²+2/(q(q-2))||K||_F². For A_q=[[0,a],[-a+kappa/sqrt(q),0]], the iid coordinate-pair vector (g_r h_r,h_r²-g_r²) has covariance diag(1,4); joint CLT and LLN denominators give qE⇒Z(kappa+2aW), independent normal Z,W. Characteristic function follows by conditioning. Checked exact rational skew formulas for q=3..14; no finite test substituted for the limit proof.
